about.title: About Me
about.body:
I'm a junior Full Stack Developer focused on building modern, accessible, and scalable solutions using React, Node.js, and TypeScript. I have experience with personal projects in accessibility, financial organization, automation, and web systems, always seeking to learn and apply best development practices.

I've developed web applications using REST APIs, front-end and back-end architecture, automated testing, and integration with various tools. My personal project highlights include ideas like EcoVoz (digital accessibility) and Control Finance (financial management).

I believe technology should create real impact and make people's lives easier. My personal journey has strengthened my empathy, resilience, and focus on solving real problems—values I bring to every coding challenge.

projects.title: Projects by Category
projects.metaDescription: Main Full Stack, Front End, and real solutions projects. See cases of technology, social impact, and innovation.

controlFinance.description: Control Finance is a web app built with React and styled with Tailwind CSS, designed for personal finance management. The interface allows users to record incomes and expenses, view the total balance, and filter transactions by type. The project demonstrates skills in front-end development and state management with React.

postit.description: Post-it Share App is a minimalist web application that allows you to create, share, and view short notes in the style of post-its. This project started in a live coding session with Mayk Brito, Rocketseat's CCO, and was improved with features like ESLint and Prettier for code standardization, as well as a copy button for easy link sharing.

kenzieHub.description: Kenzie Hub is a web app developed as part of the Kenzie Academy training program. The project aims to provide a platform where students can register and track their skills acquired throughout the course. It uses modern technologies such as React, React Hook Form for form management and validation with Zod, and SASS for styling.

hamburgueria.description: This project simulates a web app for a burger shop, developed using the React framework. It features an interactive and responsive interface, allowing users to browse the menu, add items to the cart, and view the final order. Axios is used for HTTP requests to a simulated API, and React Router manages routes.

portfolioTemplate.description: This project is a personal portfolio template developed using the React framework. It features a modern and responsive interface, allowing users to view personal information, technical skills, and completed projects. The portfolio uses Axios for API integration and React Router for route management.

newsPortal.description: News Portal is a technology news portal developed to demonstrate the ability to create modern layouts using CSS Flexbox and Grid. The project is fully responsive and includes CSS variables and pseudo-elements for better design.

decodificadorDeTextos.description: This project is a web application that allows users to encrypt and decrypt text messages using a simple substitution key. The interface is built with HTML and styled using Tailwind CSS for a responsive design. The encryption and decryption logic is implemented in JavaScript.

fylo.description: Frontend Mentor Challenge: Fylo landing page with two column layout. The challenge is to create a landing page for Fylo with a two-column layout. Users should be able to view the ideal site layout depending on the device screen size and see hover states for all interactive elements on the page.

travelgram.description: Travelgram is a social network where users share travel photos and memories. With a modern and responsive design, it offers a grid photo gallery and intuitive navigation, providing a great mobile experience.

portfolioDev.description: Portfolio Dev is a responsive portfolio site highlighting projects and skills. It features links to highlighted projects and a contact section, demonstrating knowledge in responsive design and modern development practices.

siteInstitucionalGenerico.description: This project is an example of an institutional website developed with a focus on modern web development practices. It features a responsive design that adapts perfectly to different screen sizes and devices. Using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, the site presents an intuitive and attractive interface, with effective use of Media Queries and the CSS 'clamp()' function for a smooth and accessible user experience.

openMusic.description: Kenzie Academy Brazil Challenge: Open Music. This project involves creating a web application for exploring music and albums. The challenge is to develop an intuitive and responsive interface, including dark mode functionality and CSS animations for an enhanced user experience.

buscadorCEP.description: This project is a ZIP code search tool developed in React JS. It allows users to enter a ZIP code and get detailed information about the corresponding address.

gitSearch.description: Kenzie Academy Brazil Challenge: Git Search. This project involves creating a web application to search and view GitHub profiles, integrating with the GitHub API and allowing users to dynamically and responsively explore profiles and repositories.

profileCardComponent.description: Frontend Mentor Challenge: Profile card component. The challenge is to create a responsive profile card component, including the profile image, personal information, and social media icons. The goal is to practice design and layout implementation skills using HTML and CSS.
